sections.heading: Karnataka MBBS Admission for Other State Students 2026

content.text: Karnataka MBBS admission for other states:

Karnataka MBBS admission for other state student is possible only if the candidate qualifies NEET-UG 2024, secures the minimum required marks and attends all levels of KEA counselling if interested in joining private medical colleges in Karnataka. Alternatively, if interested in joining deemed medical colleges in karnataka, they should attend MCC counselling.
2. KEA’s Role in Karnataka MBBS admission for other states:

The Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA) oversees private medical colleges’ MBBS admissions in Karnataka. KEA handles all procedures, including online registration, document verification, online counselling, seat allotment, and issuance of admission orders, in accordance with government rules. Eligibility for participating in counselling is contingent upon qualifying in NEET UG 2024, as KEA will conduct the process based on your NEET scores.
3. MCC’s Role in Deemed Medical Colleges admission:

If you are interested in joining deemed medical colleges in Karnataka, you should attend the counselling conducted by the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC). The central counselling for NEET is conducted by the MCC for admission to the 15 percent All India Quota (AIQ) seats.
4. Karnataka MBBS admission for other states students in Government Medical Colleges:

Non-Karnataka students can apply for seats in government medical colleges in Karnataka through the All India Quota (AIQ), which reserves 15% of the total seats for students from all over India. These seats are filled based on the NEET (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test) scores.

For non-Karnataka students seeking admission to government medical colleges in Karnataka, the admissions are managed through the All India Quota (AIQ) counseling process. This process is conducted by the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) under the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India.

content.text: MD MS Admission through Management Quota refers to seats reserved in private and deemed medical colleges that are filled through official counselling rounds conducted by MCC or the respective state medical counselling authorities. These seats are completely legitimate under NMC (National Medical Commission) guidelines, offered at a higher tuition fee, and provide an opportunity for candidates who may not secure government quota seats but still meet the required NEET-PG qualifying percentile.

sections.heading: MD MS Admission in Karnataka: NEET PG Medical Admission Guidance

content.text: To secure MD/MS admission in Karnataka in 2025, candidates must appear for the NEET PG 2025 exam conducted by the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) and obtain the required cutoff. Karnataka state candidates under the General/EWS category, as well as other state candidates, must qualify under the General category cutoff, while reserved category candidates of Karnataka can qualify under their respective category cutoffs. After qualifying, candidates can participate in Karnataka State Quota counselling conducted by the Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA) or in All India Quota (AIQ) and Deemed University counselling conducted by the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC).

Additionally, to gain Uttar Pradesh Medical Admission, applicants must participate in the NEET UG counseling conducted by the Directorate General of Medical Education (DGME) Uttar Pradesh for state quota seats. For seats under the all India quota, candidates should attend counseling sessions conducted by the Medical Counseling Committee (MCC).

Karnataka MBBS Admission for Other State Students 2026

Karnataka MBBS admission for other states:

Karnataka MBBS admission for other state student is possible only if the candidate qualifies NEET-UG 2024, secures the minimum required marks and attends all levels of KEA counselling if interested in joining private medical colleges in Karnataka. Alternatively, if interested in joining deemed medical colleges in karnataka, they should attend MCC counselling.

2. KEA’s Role in Karnataka MBBS admission for other states:

The Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA) oversees private medical colleges’ MBBS admissions in Karnataka. KEA handles all procedures, including online registration, document verification, online counselling, seat allotment, and issuance of admission orders, in accordance with government rules. Eligibility for participating in counselling is contingent upon qualifying in NEET UG 2024, as KEA will conduct the process based on your NEET scores.

3. MCC’s Role in Deemed Medical Colleges admission:

If you are interested in joining deemed medical colleges in Karnataka, you should attend the counselling conducted by the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC). The central counselling for NEET is conducted by the MCC for admission to the 15 percent All India Quota (AIQ) seats.

4. Karnataka MBBS admission for other states students in Government Medical Colleges:

Non-Karnataka students can apply for seats in government medical colleges in Karnataka through the All India Quota (AIQ), which reserves 15% of the total seats for students from all over India. These seats are filled based on the NEET (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test) scores.

For non-Karnataka students seeking admission to government medical colleges in Karnataka, the admissions are managed through the All India Quota (AIQ) counseling process. This process is conducted by the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) under the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India.

MBBS Admission in Delhi: Eligibility, Admission & Selection

For MBBS admission in Delhi the counselling process will be handled by MCC, DGHS, MOHFW for both 85% Delhi Quota and 15% All India Quota.

MD MS Admission through Management Quota refers to seats reserved in private and deemed medical colleges that are filled through official counselling rounds conducted by MCC or the respective state medical counselling authorities. These seats are completely legitimate under NMC (National Medical Commission) guidelines, offered at a higher tuition fee, and provide an opportunity for candidates who may not secure government quota seats but still meet the required NEET-PG qualifying percentile.

MD MS Admission in Karnataka: NEET PG Medical Admission Guidance

To secure MD/MS admission in Karnataka in 2025, candidates must appear for the NEET PG 2025 exam conducted by the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) and obtain the required cutoff. Karnataka state candidates under the General/EWS category, as well as other state candidates, must qualify under the General category cutoff, while reserved category candidates of Karnataka can qualify under their respective category cutoffs. After qualifying, candidates can participate in Karnataka State Quota counselling conducted by the Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA) or in All India Quota (AIQ) and Deemed University counselling conducted by the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC).
